# DLSSNR-AMD: the menus' texts in 中文（简体）, for NR Control (OptiScaler route) and ReShade's Add-ons page,
# Linux and Windows (0.0.8.2). Copy it with the fonts folder into dlssnr-amd\lang in the game's folder.

msgid "@language"
msgstr "中文（简体）"

# The font for the letters (fonts\ beside this file): Noto Sans CJK, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (fonts\Noto-CJK-LICENSE.txt).
msgid "@font"
msgstr "fonts/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.ttf"

msgid "Each layer is an NR pass of its own: its processing (RenoDX or wilsjo2), its network ([Network] Model, or one of its own), where it runs, and its own settings (click its name: its page). Layers at one place run in layer order; before the upscaler, then after it, then at Present. Each layer costs a network run, and a layer with another network or size its own memory."
msgstr "每个层都是一次独立的 NR 处理：它的处理方式（RenoDX 或 wilsjo2）、它的网络（[Network] Model，或它自己的）、运行位置以及它自己的设置（点击层名打开它的页面）。同一位置的层按层号顺序运行：先是超分前，然后超分后，最后在最终画面（最佳效果）。每个层都要多跑一次网络，使用其他网络或尺寸的层还要占用自己的显存。"

msgid "The OptiScaler-NR fork's processing around the network, ported."
msgstr "移植自 OptiScaler-NR 分支的网络前后处理。"

msgid "Passes. Model passes a frame, 1-3 (up to 30 with Unlock passes); each costs one more network run. Only the last pass's answer is composed onto the frame."
msgstr "Pass 次数。每帧模型处理的 Pass 数，1-3（开启“解锁 Passes”后最多 30）；每多一次 Pass 就多跑一次网络。只有最后一次 Pass 的结果会合成到画面上。"

msgid "On: pass 1's settings, with the local tone at 0 (the fork's rule for later passes). Off: this pass's own settings below."
msgstr "开：使用第 1 次的设置，局部色调为 0（分支对后续 Pass 的规则）。关：使用下面这次 Pass 自己的设置。"

msgid "[Network] Resize History. Only when NR runs before the upscaler and the game changes its render size\n(dynamic resolution):\nOff (default): NR's previous result is dropped and NR starts again at the new size, as NVIDIA's DLL does.\nOn: the previous result is scaled to the new size and kept. Steadier on our tests when the size changes\noften, but not what NVIDIA's DLL does. Games with jittered input (most DLSS games) hide most of the\nrestart, so the default is off."
msgstr "[Network] Resize History。仅当 NR 在超分前运行且游戏改变渲染尺寸时\n（动态分辨率）：\n关（默认）：丢弃 NR 之前的结果，NR 在新尺寸下重新开始，与 NVIDIA 的 DLL 相同。\n开：把之前的结果缩放到新尺寸并保留。在我们的测试中尺寸频繁变化时更稳定，\n但不是 NVIDIA 的 DLL 的做法。带抖动输入的游戏（大多数 DLSS 游戏）会掩盖大部分\n重新开始，所以默认关闭。"

Off (default): one NR run, its choices and settings on the NR settings page. Layers are not the way to run NR more than once on a frame: that is Passes."
msgstr "[NRControl] Layers。开：可以启用多个 NR 图层（见 NR 链页），每个图层都是一次完整的 NR，各有自己的处理方式、网络、运行位置和设置。关（默认）：单次 NR，选项和设置在“NR 设置”页。让 NR 在一帧上多跑几次请用 Passes，不是图层。"

msgid "auto"
msgstr "自动"

msgid "resident"
msgstr "常驻"

msgid "offload"
msgstr "移出"

msgid "minimal"
msgstr "最少"

msgid "[Network] Residency: what is kept of a network not in use. The networks share one activation memory, so mostly their weights. auto (default): the weights stay in video memory, switching back is quick; moved to RAM when video memory runs short, freed when RAM does too. resident: kept whole, switching back is instant, the most video memory. offload: the weights in RAM, all video memory freed. minimal: everything freed, switching back builds anew. While the other network gets ready, the running one keeps serving. NR off for 10 s: offload and minimal do the same to the running network, auto only when video memory is short."
msgstr "[Network] Residency：未使用的网络保留什么。各网络共用一块激活内存，所以主要是权重。auto（默认）：权重留在显存，切回很快；显存不足时移到内存，内存也不足时释放。resident：完整保留，切回即时，显存占用最多。offload：权重放在内存，显存全部释放。minimal：全部释放，切回时重新构建。另一个网络准备期间，正在运行的网络继续服务。NR 关闭 10 秒后：offload 和 minimal 对正在运行的网络也这样处理，auto 只在显存不足时。"

msgid "[HudFix] Mode. HUD FIX keeps the game's HUD (crosshair, bars, subtitles, menus) as the game drew it while NR changes the rest; for the layers placed at Present. msgid "Limit colour change (RenoDX's way)"
msgstr "限制颜色变化（RenoDX 的方式）"

msgid "ColourLimit. On (default): the colour of the network's change is bounded each pass as RenoDX bounds it, and where the highlight guard brightens a pixel it keeps the pixel's own colour, so dark face edges do not turn red or orange (worse when stacking). Off: the original wilsjo2 composition."
msgstr "ColourLimit。开（默认）：每次 Pass 都像 RenoDX 那样限制网络改动的颜色，高光保护提亮像素时保持像素自身的颜色，这样暗的脸部边缘不会变红或变橙（叠加时更明显）。关：原版 wilsjo2 的合成。"

msgid "FastMethod. Extrapolation pushes this frame's one-pass edit further along its own direction; no motion vectors needed, works from the first frame. Feedback feeds the previous frame's edit, moved by the motion vectors, back into the network input; needs motion vectors and builds up over the first frames. Hybrid uses Feedback where history holds and Extrapolation on new surfaces, cuts and edges. Edit strength scales the network's edit in stops, as Adjust NR's look's Edit strength does. Each method keeps its own settings."
msgstr "FastMethod。Extrapolation 把本帧单次的改动沿它自己的方向再推进一步；不需要运动向量，从第一帧起就生效。Feedback 把上一帧的改动按运动向量移动后送回网络输入；需要运动向量，最初几帧逐渐建立。Hybrid 在历史可靠处用 Feedback，在新表面、切镜和边缘处用 Extrapolation。改动强度（Edit strength）以档位缩放网络的改动，同“调整 NR 的效果”中的改动强度。每种方法各自保存设置。"

msgid "NRFastExtrapolationPasses. Extrapolation's strength, referred to legacy pass counts."
msgstr "NRFastExtrapolationPasses。Extrapolation 的强度，以 legacy Pass 次数为参照。"

msgid "NRFastMethod. Extrapolation pushes this frame's one-pass edit further along its own direction; no motion vectors needed, works from the first frame. Feedback feeds the previous frame's edit, moved by the motion vectors, back into the network input; needs motion vectors and builds up over the first frames. Hybrid uses Feedback where history holds and Extrapolation on new surfaces, cuts and edges. Edit strength scales the network's edit in stops, as Adjust NR's look's Edit strength does. Each method keeps its own settings."
msgstr "NRFastMethod。Extrapolation 把本帧单次的改动沿它自己的方向再推进一步；不需要运动向量，从第一帧起就生效。Feedback 把上一帧的改动按运动向量移动后送回网络输入；需要运动向量，最初几帧逐渐建立。Hybrid 在历史可靠处用 Feedback，在新表面、切镜和边缘处用 Extrapolation。改动强度（Edit strength）以档位缩放网络的改动，同“调整 NR 的效果”中的改动强度。每种方法各自保存设置。"

msgid "NRFastExtrapolationHaloLimit. Limits the halos Extrapolation adds."

msgid "[Network] Memory Guard. On (default): a network is built only while the video memory it needs is free. Off: no such check - NR builds in whatever video memory is left; a game left short of it may stutter or fail to load its own data. Applied at once."

msgid "[DlssNr] MotionVectors. The ReShade effect that estimates the motion NR's history follows. VORT comes with this package. LumeniteFX Kernel (by Afzaal) is installed separately, with install.sh --lumenite, from its author's GitHub. Switching makes ReShade compile its effects again (NR pauses until they are ready) and restarts NR's history."
msgstr "[DlssNr] MotionVectors。估计运动、供 NR 历史跟随的 ReShade 效果。VORT 随本包提供。LumeniteFX Kernel（作者 Afzaal）需另外安装，用 install.sh --lumenite 从作者的 GitHub 获取。切换会让 ReShade 重新编译效果（就绪前 NR 暂停），并重新开始 NR 的历史。"

msgid "If the picture flickers with passes, turn on Detail stability (Composition > Detail stability: Auto or Always)."
msgstr "如果多次 Pass 处理时画面闪烁，请打开细节稳定（合成 > 细节稳定：自动 或 总是）。"

msgid "16-bit"
msgstr "16 位"

msgid "32-bit"
msgstr "32 位"

msgid "History precision"
msgstr "历史精度"

msgid "[Network] History Precision: the precision of the images NR keeps its previous result in. 16-bit (default): as NVIDIA's DLL keeps it, half the video memory. 32-bit: as up to 0.0.8.1; at 4K 133 MB more a network and 66 MB more each further pass. With several passes the two can differ in fine detail. Takes effect at once; the previous result starts afresh."
msgstr "[Network] History Precision：NR 保存上一帧结果所用图像的精度。16 位（默认）：与 NVIDIA 的 DLL 相同，显存占用减半。32 位：与 0.0.8.1 及以前相同；4K 下每个网络多占 133 MB，每多一次 Pass 再多 66 MB。多次 Pass 处理时两者的细节可能略有不同。立即生效；上一帧结果重新开始。"
